title: Per-document OCR extraction API
adjacent_why: Same shape as 02 — public REST endpoint, usage pricing, free tier, API keys only, overnight batch customers, a refresh promise. Different hinge: the bill unit is a file while the cost unit is a page, so the pricing page and the invoice disagree by two orders of magnitude on the same customer.
idea: A public REST API that turns scanned PDFs into structured invoice fields — vendor, issue date, line items, totals. Pricing is per document: $0.10 per file, free tier 100 documents per month. Auth is API keys only (no OAuth yet). Each file is rendered page by page and pushed through a GPU extraction model, so a 2-page receipt and a 400-page statement bundle are billed the same. Target customers are bookkeeping tools that upload a month of client scans in one overnight batch. Model refresh is promised as 'monthly', and confidence per field is returned but not enforced.
focus_notes: Bill unit (file) vs cost unit (page) — one heavy tenant inverts gross margin
Unbounded overnight batches on a GPU queue with no per-key ceiling
Field confidence is returned but nothing gates a wrong total from reaching a ledger
'Monthly' refresh is a promise about a model whose behaviour changes silently
